document_host.note: The Idox side has no documents tab — its tab list shows 'externalDocuments', pointing at this separate host. The page is a ~12KB client-side shell titled 'Civica Town - Planning Documents'; its bootstrap script exposes the whole API contract (Civica.APIUrl and PortalSettings.PlanningApplicationRefType), so the JSON API below can be called directly. The padocs.* hostname mirrors Mid Sussex's padocs.midsussex.gov.uk but the product is Civica Town, NOT the Idox PublicAccess_Live DMS — do not infer the recipe from the hostname.

reference_format.note: LW/YY/NNNN. The prefix is what identifies a Lewes case on an install shared with Eastbourne Borough.

endpoints.note: Three plain-HTTP calls. (1) POST the search with body {"refType":"PBDC","fromRow":1,"toRow":100,"searchFields":{"ref_no":"<REF>"},"keyNumb":null,"keyText":null,"getFields":null,"NoTotalRows":null,"sort":null} -> KeyObjects[0].KeyNumber. (2) GET doc/list -> {CompleteDocument:[{DocNo,DocDesc,DocDate,TypeCode,...}],RowCount}. (3) GET doc/pagestream -> the file. Note the keying: the honoured search field is ref_no and KeyText is EMPTY on doc/list, not the constant 'Subject'. A whole-application zip is available at doc/list/zipstream?KeyNumb=..&KeyText=..&RefType=..&ProcessNo= if fewer requests are preferred.

quirks.summary: keyobject/pagedsearch must be a JSON POST — as a GET it returns HTTP 200 and silently ignores the ref_no filter, handing back the entire register.
quirks.detail: The same call as GET with searchFields[ref_no]=<REF> returned 200 with TotalRows 109,440 and no error of any kind — a trap that would poison a corpus.
quirks.workaround: POST with Content-Type: application/json and the body shape in endpoints.note, and check TotalRows against what you expect before using any row.

quirks.summary: The document store also holds South Downs National Park (SDNP/) records, so an inexact ref_no match can return another authority's application.
quirks.detail: This is the document store, not the search portal — the Idox search side is Lewes (and Eastbourne) only.
quirks.workaround: Match ref_no exactly and check the returned reference before downloading.

quirks.summary: Documents tab returned no file links for a real application.
quirks.detail: Either this application genuinely has no published documents, or the documents live somewhere the standard link pattern does not match. One application was sampled, so this is a signal, not a verdict.
quirks.workaround: Sample a second application before concluding; check for an externalDocuments tab.

robots.note: robots.txt disallows the search path for our UA

shared_portal.note: One Idox install serves both councils. Attribute an application by its reference prefix, not by the portal: Lewes cases are LW/YY/NNNN.

national_park.note: Much of Lewes District lies in the South Downs National Park, where the South Downs National Park Authority is the LPA rather than the district council.

source_notes:
ONE PORTAL, TWO COUNCILS - Lewes District and Eastbourne Borough share this Idox install; attribute by reference prefix (Lewes = LW/YY/NNNN). DOCUMENTS: SOLVED 22 Aug 2026 without a browser. The Idox side is standard (advanced-search POST, _csrf, clean 'Ref. No:' metadata) but there is no documents tab - the summary tab list shows externalDocuments, pointing at https://padocs.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk/planning/planning-documents?ref_no=<REF>. That is a 12KB shell titled 'Civica Town - Planning Documents' that renders client-side, BUT its bootstrap script exposes the whole API contract in the page source: Civica.APIUrl = '/civica/Resource/Civica/Handler.ashx/' and PortalSettings.PlanningApplicationRefType = 'PBDC'. Three calls, all plain HTTP: (1) POST <APIUrl>keyobject/pagedsearch with Content-Type application/json and body {"refType":"PBDC","fromRow":1,"toRow":100,"searchFields":{"ref_no":"<REF>"},"keyNumb":null,"keyText":null,"getFields":null,"NoTotalRows":null,"sort":null} -> KeyObjects[0].KeyNumber. MUST be POST with a JSON body: the same call as GET with searchFields[ref_no]=<REF> returns HTTP 200 and silently IGNORES the filter, handing back the entire register (TotalRows 109,440) with no error - a trap that would poison a corpus. (2) GET <APIUrl>doc/list?KeyNumb=<KeyNumber>&KeyText=&RefType=PBDC -> {CompleteDocument:[{DocNo,DocDesc,DocDate,TypeCode,...}],RowCount}. (3) GET <APIUrl>doc/pagestream?DocNo=<DocNo>&pdf=true -> the file (verified application/pdf, %PDF- magic bytes). A whole-application zip exists at doc/list/zipstream?KeyNumb=..&KeyText=..&RefType=..&ProcessNo= if fewer requests are preferred. Send X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest.

The document store DOES hold SDNP/ (South Downs National Park) records, so a ref_no search must be exact or results cross authority boundaries - note that is the document store, not the search portal, which is Lewes-only. Beware the hostname: padocs.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk matches Mid Sussex's padocs.midsussex.gov.uk naming, but the product behind it is Civica Town, not the PublicAccess_Live DMS - do not infer the recipe from the hostname. Scope caveat: much of Lewes District is in the South Downs National Park where SDNPA is the LPA.

verification.note: Solved without a browser: Idox search -> externalDocuments -> Civica Town JSON API (pagedsearch -> doc/list -> doc/pagestream). The file came back as application/pdf with %PDF- magic bytes.
